name: @robrowser-webgpu/gpu-webgl2
description: gpu-webgl2 fallback backend of the reimagined renderer: the legacy WebGL2 renderer refactored to consume backend-neutral render records, with run-length batching (instanced quads), texture-array residency, the same GPU-side rules as gpu-webgpu, and context lost/restored handling. GLSL 300 es.
